name: get_bulk_price
description:
Get price data for up to 50 domains. The optional years input sets the term; if omitted, each TLD's minimum term is used. Read-only; does not purchase anything.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} domains price {domain1} {domain2}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domains.description: an array of at most 50 item(s)
domains.title: maxItems(50)

years.description: The number of years to get the price for. If not provided, the minimum number of years for the TLD will be used.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
